newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica comments on analysts forecasts.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica comments on analysts forecasts.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp chief financial officer Michael O'Neill said Wall Street analysts have a pretty good handle on earnings forecasts for the bank, but declined to make any projections.

"The further you go out the less you can be comfortable with. I think the street covers us pretty well and has a pretty good handle on it," he told reporters when asked if he was comfortable with 1997 full year forecasts of $8.49 a share and 1998 forecasts of $9.60 per share.
The company reported earnings of $7.49 a share in 1996.
